CREATE TABLE "public"."analytics_snapshot" (
  "asOf" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "collectedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "completeness" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "definition" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metricKey" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "provenance" text NOT NULL,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "publicationId" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "value" int4 NOT NULL,
  "windowEnd" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "windowStart" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."optimization_recommendation" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "confidence" text NOT NULL,
  "confidenceRationale" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "dedupeKey" text NOT NULL,
  "evidence" text NOT NULL,
  "explanation" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "limitations" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "proposedChanges" text NOT NULL,
  "resultPublicationId" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "suggestedAction" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "optimization_recommendation_category_check_303df0ee" CHECK ("category" IN ('PERFORMANCE_OUTLIER', 'TIMING_WINDOW')),
  CONSTRAINT "optimization_recommendation_confidence_check_fefd3199" CHECK ("confidence" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH')),
  CONSTRAINT "optimization_recommendation_status_check_9d39a3d0" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'ACCEPTED', 'DISMISSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publication" (
  "analyticsClaimedAt" timestamptz,
  "analyticsCollectedAt" timestamptz,
  "analyticsErrorCode" text,
  "analyticsErrorMessage" text,
  "analyticsRequestedAt" timestamptz,
  "attemptedCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "cancelledAt" timestamptz,
  "connectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "externalPostId" text,
  "externalPublishedAt" timestamptz,
  "externalUrl" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "lastErrorCode" text,
  "lastErrorMessage" text,
  "lastErrorRetryable" bool,
  "originPublicationId" text,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "recommendationId" text,
  "scheduledFor" timestamptz,
  "scheduledTimezone" text,
  "sourceHash" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceRevision" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceSnapshot" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceType" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "validatedAt" timestamptz,
  "validation" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "publication_sourceType_check_dbef7823" CHECK ("sourceType" IN ('WRITING_DOCUMENT', 'CAMPAIGN_DELIVERABLE')),
  CONSTRAINT "publication_status_check_a23779dd" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'READY', 'SCHEDULED', 'QUEUED', 'PUBLISHING', 'PUBLISHED', 'FAILED', 'AMBIGUOUS', 'AUTH_REQUIRED', 'STALE', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publish_attempt" (
  "attemptNumber" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "errorCode" text,
  "errorMessage" text,
  "finishedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" text,
  "outcome" text NOT NULL,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "providerRequestId" text,
  "publicationId" text NOT NULL,
  "retryable" bool,
  "startedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "publish_attempt_outcome_check_b73358e1" CHECK ("outcome" IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'AMBIGUOUS'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publishing_connection" (
  "capabilities" text NOT NULL,
  "connectedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "credentialCiphertext" text,
  "credentialExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "disconnectedAt" timestamptz,
  "displayName" text NOT NULL,
  "externalAccountId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastCheckedAt" timestamptz,
  "lastErrorCode" text,
  "projectId" text NOT NULL,
  "providerId" text NOT NULL,
  "scopes" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'CONNECTED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "publishing_connection_status_check_711b8ed1" CHECK ("status" IN ('CONNECTED', 'AUTH_REQUIRED', 'REVOKED', 'DISCONNECTED'))
)
